'''Rebel sentries'''<ref name="Front Runners trivia gallery">{{SW|url=series/clone-wars/front-runners-trivia-gallery|text="Front Runners" Trivia Gallery}}</ref> were [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] personnel who monitored incoming and departing [[Starship/Legends|starships]]<ref name="ANH" /> and kept watch for [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Scout/Legends|scouts]] and other hazards<ref name="CCG">{{CCG|set=Premiere Limited|cardname=Yavin Sentry}}</ref> from the top of a [[Sentry tower/Legends|recon-tower]] near the [[Great Temple/Legends|Massassi Temple]], the Rebellion's headquarters on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="ANH" /> [[Osleo Prennert]] was a Rebel sentry posted during the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}}]] arrival at Yavin 4 in [[0 BBY/Legends|0 BBY]] and during the [[Moon/Legends|moon's]] [[Raid on Yavin 4|occupation]] by the Galactic Empire.<ref name="Insider 92">{{InsiderCite|92|Refresher Reading}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Rebel sentry first appeared in the first ''[[Star Wars]]'' film, [[Star Wars: Episode IV A New Hope|''Star Wars'': Episode IV ''A New Hope'']], released on [[May 25]], [[1977]].<ref name="ANH" /> The sentry was played by [[Industrial Light & Magic]]'s [[Lorne Peterson]], who said that he conducted the dangerous job of standing in the recon-tower because he was the only one in the special effects crew who had no children. The device that Peterson was holding during the scene was a pair of light meters taped together.<ref name="Lorne Peterson interview">{{SWYouTube|M7oQHQkNdkA|Steve Gawley and Lorne Peterson Interview with StarWars.com &#124; Star Wars Celebration Anaheim}}</ref>
